scripts.render: remotion render src/index.tsx InvasionPart1 out/picture.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -i out/picture.mp4 -i public/input.mp4 -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c copy -movflags +faststart ../final_remotion_part1_subtitles.mp4 -y

scripts.render:trailer:v2: remotion render src/index.tsx InvasionTrailerV2 out/trailer_v2_picture.mp4 --concurrency=2 && python3 scripts/mix_trailer_v2.py
scripts.render:trailer:voice: remotion render src/index.tsx InvasionTrailerVoice out/trailer_voice_picture.mp4 --concurrency=2 && python3 scripts/mix_trailer_v2.py --voice
scripts.render:trailer:v3: remotion render src/index.tsx InvasionTrailerV3 out/trailer_v3_picture.mp4 --concurrency=2 && python3 scripts/mix_trailer_v3.py
